notes.title: Update Notes for March 24th
notes.content:
Minor update:

- Added some minor visual updates to the city
- Minor visual update for tutorial cafe (to make it look nighttime)
- Minor visual update for main menu
- Small adjustments to tutorial triggers so there's less chance of a trigger breaking
- Added additional idling NPCs (There are ones sitting down now)
- Added icons on roof to make it easier to distinguish between the factory types
- Sage now has an easier time interacting with objects from unusual angles
- Added sound to oven when it is baking
- Coffee maker has more sounds
- Activating Red/Blue/Green potions now plays a sound effect

notes.title: Patch 9/4/2023
notes.content:
This is a small patch to (preemptively) celebrate the one year anniversary since Crescent Cauldron Cafe has been released! It's wild to think its already been a year.

[b]Patch notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Made some minor graphical changes
[*] Fixed a few small lighting issues
[*] Added Steam cloud save support
[*] Added Steam Achievements
[*] Fixed a bug that would sometimes prevent the game from launching
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed a few small lighting issues
Fixed a bug that would sometimes prevent the game from launching

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
- Setting volume options for music or effects should now correctly save
- Minor lighting changes on main menu and end of day
- Plants are now correctly lit
- Mercury now longer makes a 'hit' sound when running into things (unless she is flying on her broom)
- Adjusted 'end of day' music track so it fades in much better
- Sleeping on the beds at the end of day should be less finicky

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
More fixes for issues:

- Fixed a UI issue where the logo could block part of the options menu
- Setting the game to fullscreen should set it to your desktop resolution now
- The Upgrade Table incorrectly stated it was [unavailable] even though it was
- The splashscreen should show now on game start-up (its skippable)
- Updated a music track so it followed the volume controls the correct way

notes.content:
Small hotfix but important:

- Fixed an issue where the timed puzzle for making coffee would sometimes fail if you get it within the last ~7% of the 'success zone'.
